title: terminalia franchetii var. intricata
intro: Terminalia franchetii var. intricata, commonly known as the 'Himalayan Chebula' or 'Mountain Chebula', is a plant species of the Combretaceae family. It is native to the Himalayan region and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of this plant include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and anti-hypertensive effects.
